translations.web: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”
translations.bsb: Then the officers returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”
translations.kjv: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why have ye not brought him?
translations.asv: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said unto them, Why did ye not bring him?
